# News chain fixture

**Bottom line:** A published report proves publication, not automatically the underlying event. ([Example source](https://example.com/news))

## News provenance chain

| Stage | Source / outlet | Role | Independent? | Status / gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Event | Official source | Original evidence | Yes | Unknown outcome |
| Report | News outlet | Publication | No, shared source | No correction yet |
| Response | Affected party | Response | Unclear | Unresolved claim |
